about.record: {form, hash, expected, rewrite?}: opening <page>#<hash> with the baseline code gives `expected`, and the page writes back `rewrite` (or `hash` itself when absent)

expected.masteries: classic: {total, trees: [{key: rank} x3], name?, notes?}; keystone: {total, trees: {treeId: {key: rank}}, keystone: key|null, name?} (the keystone is also in its tree map with rank 1)
expected.runes: {slots: [30 rune ids or null, slot order mark x9, seal x9, glyph x9, quintessence x3], level}
expected.reforged: {primary: {path, picks: [keystone, row1, row2, row3]}|null, secondary: {path, picks: [row1, row2, row3]}|null, shards: [offense, flex, defense], name}

forms.named: random build with a page name segment
forms.coverage: built to put a mastery at its max rank
forms.uniform: rune page with one or two runes per colour
forms.event: event runes in every slot they fit
forms.legacy-wide-field: old link: a field wider than the corrected mastery (hashRanks > ranks); the value clamps and `notes` is the toast
forms.tilde: '~' + code in the current widths (a rank the legacy width cannot hold)
forms.tilde-fits-legacy: '~' code whose build fits the legacy widths; re-exported without '~'
forms.plain: no '<id>|' prefix: the page's default set
forms.name-normalized: page name with extra whitespace; the sidebar collapses it
forms.full: keystone + 3 runes, 2 secondary runes, all shards
forms.percent-encoded: a full link pasted percent-encoded once

about.views: the 23 baseline views (DESIGN §6 P0-A): empty view, sample build, and a tooltip target per legacy id; shots via `capture-legacy.js shots`
